decisions.briefing: Markets were mildly negative today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.6%) — not the kind of risk-on move that has historically confirmed strong follow-through. Even though 3 slots and $589 cash are available, none of today's setups (aside from FRMI and LGN clearing all four confirmation signals) came with the breadth of market strength that's paid off before, so we're holding cash rather than forcing a buy. Existing positions are left to run — profit targets and stop-losses will handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Equities drifted slightly lower today with the S&P 500 down 0.6% and the Nasdaq off 0.3%, a mild pullback rather than a decisive move in either direction. Without a clear catalyst pushing the market strongly higher, momentum-driven setups are less reliable, so today's action looked more like consolidation than a genuine trend shift. Broader participation and stronger volume would typically be needed to confirm the next leg up.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股輕微下跌，標普500指數跌0.6%，納指跌0.3%，屬溫和回調而非明確方向性走勢。由於缺乏明顯催化劑推動大盤走強，動能類交易訊號的可靠性相對較低，今日走勢較似整固而非趨勢轉變。若要確認下一波升浪，通常需要更廣泛的參與度及更強的成交量配合。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Just because you have cash and open slots doesn't mean you should buy — on a neutral or slightly negative day, forcing a trade just to 'stay invested' often means buying into weak conviction. Waiting for a genuine risk-on signal, like a strong broad market rally, tends to produce better entries than deploying capital on autopilot.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使手頭有現金及空置倉位，也不代表一定要立即買入——在市場中性或輕微偏弱的日子，勉強交易只為「保持持倉」，往往代表信心不足的決定。耐心等待真正的風險偏好訊號（例如大盤明顯造好），通常比機械式部署資金更能帶來理想的入市時機。
